description.en: The application ID. You can call [QueryStudioAppList](~~216816~~) to query it.
The domain ID. You can call [QueryStudioAppDomainListOpen](~~216814~~) to view it.

description.zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must include it in the request; otherwise, the invocation will fail.</props>

<props="china">
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.15b03118ooIo9y)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。
description.en:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Application Development Console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.15b03118ooIo9y). In the upper-left corner of the page, select the corresponding instance, and then click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click its project card, and then check the address bar of your browser.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send up to 10 queries per second (QPS) when calling this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of their Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot delete-studio-app-domain-open --app-id a12000000 --domain-id 1 --project-id a1230000000 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
